name: Torque Auto Repair
tagline: An independent shop for every make and model. We show you the problem, price it before we start, and fix nothing you haven't approved.
hours_note: Closed Sundays. Drop-off key box by the front door, any hour.
labor_rate: $120 an hour, posted and never padded
plate_label: A license plate reading TORQUE, Columbus, Ohio — Honest repairs since 1998, in a Serviced by Torque Auto Repair frame

service_groups.name: Maintenance
service_groups.note: The things your owner's manual keeps asking for

service_groups.name: Brakes & tires
service_groups.note: Stopping, steering, and the four patches that touch the road

service_groups.name: Diagnostics & repair
service_groups.note: When something sounds, smells, or feels wrong

process_steps.title: Drop it off
process_steps.body: Book a time or leave the keys in the drop box. Tell us what it's doing — noises, smells, when it started.

process_steps.title: We call with findings
process_steps.body: A technician inspects it and we send photos of what we found, in plain English, the same day.

process_steps.title: You approve the price
process_steps.body: Every line priced before a wrench turns. Say yes to all of it, some of it, or none of it.

process_steps.title: Pick it up
process_steps.body: We text when it's ready. Old parts in the trunk if you want them, and the warranty on the invoice.

estimate.note: Nothing gets fixed until you say yes.

promises: Free check-up with every service — tires, fluids, belts, lights
Photos of anything we recommend, sent to your phone
Free shuttle within 5 miles, or a loaner by reservation

faqs.question: Do you work on my make?
faqs.answer: Almost certainly. We service domestic, Asian and European cars, light trucks and hybrids. We don't do motorcycles or heavy diesel.

faqs.question: Will servicing here void my factory warranty?
faqs.answer: No. Federal law lets you have maintenance done anywhere. We use parts that meet factory spec and keep a record you can show the dealer.

faqs.question: What does a diagnosis cost?
faqs.answer: A check-engine scan and road test is $89. If you go ahead with the repair here, we take that off the bill.

faqs.question: How long will my car be here?
faqs.answer: Most maintenance is done while you wait or by lunch. Bigger repairs depend on parts — we'll give you a time when we call with the price.

faqs.question: What if the problem comes back?
faqs.answer: Our repairs carry a 24-month / 24,000-mile parts and labor warranty. Bring it back and we make it right.

art_direction.identity: State-issued plate stock: cool reflective white, petrol-teal stamped lettering, embossed rims and bolt holes, one sticker-red accent. Plain, confident, numerate. No dark garage photos, no wrench icons, no neon.
art_direction.type: Saira Condensed (weights 600–800) for headings, prices and the plate — stamped, squarish, automotive. Public Sans for everything else. No third family.
art_direction.color: One accent: sticker red (bg-primary) for the Book service button, the registration sticker and the one urgent warning light. The dark petrol field (bg-field) carries the warning-light band. Amber is data, used only for caution telltales.
art_direction.signature: The license plate in its 'Serviced by' dealer frame (hero and 404), the dashboard-light decoder, the posted price board, and the sample estimate waiting on the customer's OK. Keep all four as the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: The service writer you trust: plain-spoken, specific, numbers over adjectives. Here's what it is, here's what it costs. No exclamation points, no 'drive with confidence'.
